facts.heading: Tomas is nervous about therapy
facts.content: Tomas is nervous about attending therapy.
facts.evidence: I am quite nervous, if I am to be honest.

facts.heading: Wife wants Tomas to change
facts.content: Tomas's wife feels that the current situation cannot continue.
facts.evidence: My wife. She says it can't go on like this.

facts.heading: Compulsive checking behavior
facts.content: Tomas checks if he locked the door and turned off the stove thirty times a night.
facts.evidence: Thirty times a night I check if I locked the door and turned off the stove

facts.heading: Time taken to leave apartment
facts.content: It takes Tomas an hour to leave the apartment.
facts.evidence: it takes me an hour to leave the apartment.

facts.heading: Checking routine details
facts.content: Tomas checks the door, goes to the elevator, returns to pull the handle, checks stove knobs, and checks the door again.
facts.evidence: I lock the door, I go to the elevator, I come back and pull the handle. Then I check the stove, every knob separately. Then the door again.

facts.heading: Relief followed by intrusive thought
facts.content: After checking, Tomas feels relieved briefly, but then an image of not doing it properly comes to his head.
facts.evidence: I feel relieved for a while. And then an image comes into my head that I didn't do it properly,

facts.heading: Intrusive fire image
facts.content: Tomas sees a clear image of the apartment on fire.
facts.evidence: The apartment on fire. I see it clearly, like a film.

facts.heading: Frequency of intrusive thoughts
facts.content: Tomas experiences these thoughts every day, especially in the evening and morning.
facts.evidence: Every day. It's the worst in the evening when we go out or go to sleep. In the morning too.

facts.heading: Fire incident started two years ago
facts.content: The issues started two years ago after the neighbors' house caught fire and they evacuated.
facts.evidence: It started two years ago when the neighbors' house caught fire and we had to evacuate.

facts.heading: Experience during fire
facts.content: Tomas was woken up by the alarm during the fire, seeing smoke and people screaming.
facts.evidence: The alarm woke me up. There was smoke in the hallway and people were screaming.

facts.heading: Feeling of responsibility for fire
facts.content: Since the fire, Tomas feels he can cause it and will be to blame if he doesn't control something.
facts.evidence: Since then I have the feeling that I can cause it. That if I don't control something, it will happen and I will be to blame.

facts.heading: Anxiety response to resisting
facts.content: When Tomas tries to let go of the need to check, anxiety grows until he feels like he is going crazy.
facts.evidence: And then anxiety grows in me, until I feel like I'm going crazy.

facts.heading: Physical symptoms of anxiety
facts.content: Tomas experiences heart symptoms, sweating, shaking hands, and stomach sickness when anxious.
facts.evidence: Heart, sweat. My hands shake and I feel sick in my stomach.

facts.heading: Wife knows about the issue
facts.content: Tomas's wife, Barbora, knows about his issue.
facts.evidence: Barbora. My wife.

facts.heading: Wife's reaction to condition
facts.content: Barbora initially saw the behavior as a habit, but now she sees it is more serious.
facts.evidence: At first she took it as a habit, now she sees that it's more.

facts.heading: Late arrival at cinema
facts.content: Tomas arrived at the cinema forty minutes late yesterday.
facts.evidence: Yesterday we arrived at the cinema forty minutes later.

facts.heading: Wife waited for checking
facts.content: Barbora waited outside for Tomas to return and check the stove for the third time.
facts.evidence: She waited outside for me to return and check the stove for the third time.

facts.heading: Tomas feels shame
facts.content: Tomas felt shame and felt like a child who can't leave the house.
facts.evidence: Shame. I felt like a child who can't leave the house.

facts.heading: Works as electrician in Olomouc
facts.content: Tomas works as an electrician in Olomouc. He does wiring in apartments and houses.
facts.evidence: I work as an electrician in Olomouc. I do wiring in apartments and sometimes in houses.

facts.heading: Checks wiring due to fear
facts.content: Tomas checks wiring because he is afraid of making a mistake that could cause something to burn.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid that because of my head I will make a mistake once. That I will connect a wire incorrectly and something will burn.

facts.heading: Checks after every job
facts.content: Tomas goes back to check after every job, sometimes the next day.
facts.evidence: after every job I go back and check. Sometimes I go back the next day, just to look.

facts.heading: Colleagues call him pedant
facts.content: Tomas's colleagues think he is a pedant.
facts.evidence: They think I'm a pedant.

facts.heading: Boss sees him as careful
facts.content: Tomas's boss considers him the most careful in the company.
facts.evidence: The boss tells me I'm the most careful in the company

facts.heading: Checking adds one hour daily
facts.content: In the last few months, checking adds one hour of work to Tomas every day.
facts.evidence: In the last few months, it adds an hour of work to me every day.

facts.heading: Handed over jobs due to time
facts.content: Tomas has handed over a few jobs to a colleague because he didn't have time.
facts.evidence: I have already handed over a few jobs to a colleague because I didn't have time.

facts.heading: Fears losing job now
facts.content: Tomas is afraid he will lose his job, especially now.
facts.evidence: I'm afraid I'll lose my job. Especially now.

facts.heading: Barbora is four months pregnant
facts.content: Barbora is four months pregnant.
facts.evidence: Barbora is four months pregnant.

facts.heading: Waited three years for pregnancy
facts.content: Tomas and Barbora waited for the pregnancy for three years.
facts.evidence: We waited for it for three years.

facts.heading: Intrusive thought of harming partner
facts.content: Tomas has the thought that he will harm Barbora and the baby.
facts.evidence: That I will harm her and the baby.

facts.heading: Thought occurs while doing tasks
facts.content: The thought of harming them might occur while cutting bread or standing by the stairs.
facts.evidence: maybe when I'm cutting bread or standing by the stairs.

facts.heading: Has never told anyone about thought
facts.content: Tomas has never told anyone about the thought, not even Barbora.
facts.evidence: I've never told anyone about it, not even Barbora.

facts.heading: Leaves room or checks to stop thought
facts.content: When the thought appears, Tomas leaves the room or goes back to check something to make it stop.
facts.evidence: I leave the room. Or I go back and check something to make it stop.

facts.heading: Sleeps terribly at night
facts.content: Tomas sleeps terribly, waking up twice at night to check the stove.
facts.evidence: I sleep terribly. I wake up twice at night and check the stove, even if there is nothing on it.

facts.heading: Walks with Barbora twice weekly
facts.content: Tomas walks with Barbora twice a week.
facts.evidence: Walks twice a week

facts.heading: Fixing things keeps him busy
facts.content: Fixing things at home keeps Tomas busy.
facts.evidence: when I fix something at home, it keeps me busy.

facts.heading: Goals for future
facts.content: Tomas wants to leave the apartment in five minutes and look forward to having a child without those thoughts.
facts.evidence: To leave the apartment in five minutes. And to look forward to a child without those thoughts.

facts.heading: Fear of exposure therapy
facts.content: Tomas was afraid of therapy where a person is gradually exposed to what they are afraid of.
facts.evidence: I was afraid of that.

facts.heading: Fear of being forced
facts.content: Tomas thought someone would force him to leave the door open and go.
facts.evidence: I thought someone would force me to leave the door open and go.

facts.heading: Difficulty with small steps
facts.content: Even checking the door once is big for Tomas.
facts.evidence: But even that is big for me.

facts.heading: Love for Barbora
facts.content: Tomas told the therapist that he loves Barbora.
facts.evidence: That I love her.

facts.heading: Need for treatment to keep Barbora
facts.content: Tomas feels he needs to get treated so he does not lose Barbora.
facts.evidence: And that I need to get treated so I don't lose her.

facts.heading: Fear of Barbora's feelings
facts.content: Tomas is afraid that Barbora would not want to be with him right now.
facts.evidence: Right now I'm afraid she wouldn't want to be with me.

facts.heading: Barbora's expected reaction
facts.content: Tomas believes Barbora would probably hug him.
facts.evidence: She would probably hug me.

facts.heading: Agreement to try door check
facts.content: Tomas agreed to try checking the door once and writing down a number.
facts.evidence: Once. I'll try it.

facts.heading: Rating anxiety level
facts.content: Tomas agreed to write down a number from one to ten regarding his feelings.
facts.evidence: I'll write down a number from one to ten.
